content: hi, i need you to builde me an app

Okay, let’s start building your app! To get us started, I need some information.

First, what is the business use of the product? (e.g., what problem does it solve?)
its in the health business and it solves the wrong info cancer patients are getting

Okay, that’s a really important and impactful goal. So, the app will help combat misinformation regarding cancer patients – fantastic.

Now, who are the target users for this product?
cancer patients and doctors

Got it – cancer patients and doctors. That gives us a really clear focus.

Next, what are your delivery preferences? (e.g., MVP, full product, etc.)
full product
Okay, a full product – that’s a significant undertaking! To help me understand the scope, when do you plan to start the project? (timeline, if not mentioned already)
in 12 weeks
Twelve weeks – that’s a great timeframe to aim for. Let’s dig a little deeper. What is your goal for the product? (optional)
give cancer treatments the right info from the best doctors

Okay, so the ultimate goal is to provide cancer patients with the most accurate treatment information sourced from the best doctors.

Now, let’s get some specifics. What is your full name?
pini shahmurov
Okay, Pini Shahmurov. And what is your email?
ShahmurovPini@gmail.com
Thank you, Pini. Now, company name?
Shahmurov Solutions
And company location?
Ariel, Israel
Finally, a phone number (optional)?
no

Okay, Pini Shahmurov of Shahmurov Solutions, located in Ariel, Israel. Thank you for the information. Let’s recap: We’re building an app to provide cancer patients with the right information from the best doctors. The goal is a full product.

Would you like to speak with someone from our team to take the next step?
